notes: Condition b says that the cohomology action of every indicated algebraic correspondence from a smooth proper connected curve has image in the image of i* from (***). The first displayed coefficient parentheses are malformed in the ink and are not repaired.

The motif gloss is explicitly conditional: “Si on admet le yoga des motifs, justifiable par les” followed by typed double quotes around “conjectures standard”. It identifies the vanishing of the inserted “plus grand” level-1 part of the motif with realization Coker i*. This is transcribed, not proved.

The conclusion decomposes an algebraically trivial cycle z as i*(z prime)+z double prime, where z prime is algebraically trivial and z double prime is a difference of fibres of the inserted Q-cycle with zero induced cohomology map.

The proof uses the algebraic map v to obtain a cycle Z prime and subtracts its pullback. It writes (iv)Z=i(vZ) with unstarred i; H explicitly notes this, and the source is retained. Cohomology coefficient/twist arguments omitted in the proof are not supplied.
The two left coefficient Qs are pen replacements over recoverable typed Zs. Source-layer and deletion decisions are visual, independent of the expected rational coefficients.

The page ends by beginning section 3 for proper smooth X and Y over S with the pen insertion régulier before connexe, and an S-morphism i:Y to X. The right hook on the inserted word is a guide, not punctuation.

Only the single conditional linear-algebra check recorded in check_events was performed. No validation of the cited hypotheses a, standard conjectures, algebraicity of v, existence of Z prime, or the entire decomposition theorem is claimed.

H global notes about machine ell, constant-sheaf underlining and emphasis were credited. Mere missing H handwritten wrappers and coefficient bold-versus-underlined house typography were not counted as differences. H explanatory notes were not treated as authorial text.

Serifed baseline x versus rendered multiplication cross is recorded as a visible source-glyph difference at each occurrence. Equivalent arrow commands, Coker/Im operator commands, tag/list macros and H final-equation display formatting were not counted as semantic differences.

No diagrams, independent drawings, footnotes or independent authorial margin prose are present. The only margin material is the handwritten manuscript 4 and the pencil-like archive number 12. Pale scan-edge traces were not promoted to authorial marks.

check_events.outcome: Conditional local check only. Let A be the cohomology map denoted i in (iv)Z and interpret the equality invoked from a) as Av acting identically on Im A. Assuming b) places Im Z inside Im A, for every u one has (Z-AvZ)(u)=Z(u)-Av(Z(u))=0. This checks the zero-action step under exactly that local identity. It does not establish a), algebraicity of v, existence of a representing Z prime, or the compatibility of cycle pullback and cohomology; those remain transcribed assumptions/claims. No formal certificate was produced.

brief_feedback: No substantive clarification needed. The supplied H global notes and the distinction between visible x-out cells and recoverable old letters were material. The whole-image coordinates, half overlap, and one-crop restriction were workable; no additional reader files or page images were consulted.
